kultivator.beasts.awaken: The pill dissolves into the blood of %s. Spirit qi floods its meridians: it awakens! It is now: %s.
kultivator.beasts.awaken.bond: A spirit bond now links you. It grows by fighting at your side and by more pills; at %s spirit XP it evolves for the first time.
kultivator.beasts.fox_trust: The fox's wary eyes soften. It trusts you now.
kultivator.beasts.pill.xp: %s swallows the pill eagerly: +%s spirit XP (%s/%s).
kultivator.beasts.pill.digesting: %s is still refining the last pill. Wait %s s.
kultivator.beasts.refuse.wild_wolf: This wolf is still wild. Tame it with bones first, then feed it the pill.
kultivator.beasts.refuse.other_owner: This beast is bound to another master. Its spirit rejects your pill.
kultivator.beasts.refuse.untrusted_fox: This fox does not trust you yet. Breed two foxes with sweet berries: the cub will trust you.
kultivator.beasts.evolve.title: Evolution!
kultivator.beasts.evolve.subtitle: %s · Tier %s
kultivator.beasts.evolve.chat: %s breaks through its bloodline! It is now a %s (Tier %s).
kultivator.beasts.evolve.blocked: %s has gathered enough spirit for Tier %s, but a beast cannot surpass its master: you must reach %s first.
kultivator.beasts.ability.stronger: Its body grows: more health, a stronger bite and swifter legs. Its wounds close at once.
kultivator.beasts.ability.moon_thunder: New ability: Moon Thunder. Its bites sometimes call down a thunder strike (+50%% damage).
kultivator.beasts.ability.foxfire: New ability: Foxfire. Its bites set enemies ablaze.
kultivator.beasts.ability.blessing_wolf: New ability: Heavenly Guardian. Near it your wounds close slowly, and at night you gain Regeneration.
kultivator.beasts.ability.blessing_fox: New ability: Nine-Tailed Blessing. Near it your wounds close slowly and your steps grow swift.
kultivator.beasts.list.none: None of your spirit beasts are loaded nearby. Feed a Spirit Beast Pill to a wolf you tamed or to a fox that trusts you.
kultivator.beasts.debug.no_target: Look at a wolf or a fox within 8 blocks.
kultivator.beasts.debug.not_beast: That animal is not a spirit beast and cannot be awakened for you (a wolf must be tamed by you).
kultivator.beasts.tooltip.effect: Awakens a wolf you tamed, or a fox that trusts you, as a spirit beast
kultivator.beasts.tooltip.feed: Fed to your spirit beast: +%s spirit XP (once every %s s)
kultivator.beasts.tooltip.use: Right-click the animal to feed it
advancement.kultivator.spirit_beast.desc: Awaken a tamed wolf or a fox that trusts you with a Spirit Beast Pill
advancement.kultivator.beast_evolved.des: Let a spirit beast evolve to a higher tier
advancement.kultivator.beast_ascended.de: Raise a spirit beast to Tier 3: a Heavenly Wolf or a Nine-Tailed Fox
advancement.kultivator.beast_pair.title: Wolf and Fox
advancement.kultivator.beast_pair.descri: Have a spirit wolf and a spirit fox at the same time
